articles.author: Josephine Walker
articles.title: Trump takes his "Lake America" push to Apple - Axios
articles.description: The request comes after Google changed the lake's name on mobile and desktop for U.S. users on Saturday.
articles.content:
Driving the news: Apple Maps was slower than Google to make a similar change when Trump renamed the Gulf of Mexico Gulf of America and Mount Denali to Mount McKinley this year.
